parameters: κ (concentration of cholera for 50% infection chance)
description: An ordinary differential equation (ODE) model of cholera transmission dynamics based on a Susceptible-Infected-Recovered (SIR) structure for the human population and a compartment for the cholera bacterial concentration in a water reservoir (B). The paper promises to discuss how this basic model can be modified to incorporate asymptomatic infections, waning immunity, and the impact of interventions such as treatment, vaccination (OCV), and water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH).
